task_summary: Formalize the settled Envoy enforcement boundary and Catalog access-request journey before implementation.

source_records.content: GenioOne uses Envoy AI Gateway as the gateway implementation.
Authorization uses Envoy external authorization and request quotas use Envoy rate-limit integration. Product services own policy data and do not replace proxy behavior.

An authenticated user can find repository.search for live-engineering-repository in the self-service Catalog, choose TTL 1h, 8h, or 24h, submit an access request, and see a submitted result. The resource owner approves it.
